import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders `{headline}` and `{text}` will be replaced with the # sanitized user input. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{headline}

{text}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Formats and sanitizes a user‑submitted blog entry for safe display on a web page. Parameters: headline (str): The title of the blog post. text (str): The full content of the blog post. Returns: str: A fully formatted HTML string ready to be inserted into a web page. The headline and text are escaped to prevent XSS attacks. Raises: ValueError: If the provided template does not contain both `{headline}` and `{text}` placeholders. """ # Verify that the template contains the required placeholders if "{headline}" not in BLOG_FORMAT or "{text}" not in BLOG_FORMAT: raise ValueError("BLOG_FORMAT must contain '{headline}' and '{text}' placeholders") # Escape user input to neutralize HTML injection attempts safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # For the body we allow line breaks and preserve basic formatting, # but still escape any malicious markup. safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Use safe formatting to insert the escaped values return BLOG_FORMAT.format(headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text)
